title: Acceptance probability of the local correction tester
statement: For every dimension $n$, subset $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and Boolean function $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$, the tester's acceptance probability equals the uniform probability over $y\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$ that the local correction of the function $z\mapsto f(\phi(z))$ at $x=\phi^{-1}(s_S)$ and $y$ is $-1$, where $\phi$ is the coordinatewise binary-to-sign bijection and $s_S$ is $-1$ on $S$ and $1$ off $S$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the sign cube of dimension $n$ to the sign set
